scenes.label: Meet Kabir
scenes.title: The family passphrase
scenes.caption: Saturday morning at Kabir's house. The family chat is full of Sameer Chacha's travel videos: he's filming street food and train rides on his work trip. Last month, after a news report about voice scams, Kabir's parents set up a secret family passphrase. Only the family knows it. Kabir thought it sounded like a spy movie.
scenes.dialogue: A secret passphrase? Like real spies!

scenes.label: The voice note
scenes.title: “Send it now. Tell no one.”
scenes.caption: Then a voice note reaches Dad from a new number. It's Sameer Chacha's voice, breathless and scared: I've had an accident. My phone is broken, this is a friend's. Send ₹20,000 right now for the hospital, and don't tell anyone. Dad goes pale and opens his payment app. It really does sound exactly like Chacha.
scenes.speech: Then a voice note reaches Dad from a new number. It's Sameer Chacha's voice, breathless and scared: I've had an accident. My phone is broken, this is a friend's. Send twenty thousand rupees right now for the hospital, and don't tell anyone. Dad goes pale and opens his payment app. It really does sound exactly like Chacha.
scenes.dialogue: That's Chacha's voice. But something feels wrong.

scenes.label: Voice cloning
scenes.title: A familiar voice isn't proof.
scenes.caption: Kabir touches Dad's arm. At school they learned that AI can now copy a voice from just a few seconds of audio, like the clips in Chacha's travel videos. This is called voice cloning. So a familiar voice isn't proof. A new number, panic, secrecy and money: those are the real clues. Time for the passphrase.

scenes.dialogue: Dad, wait. A voice can be copied now.

scenes.label: Verify first
scenes.title: Passphrase first. Then call back.
scenes.caption: Your turn. Help Kabir and Dad verify before anyone pays. First, choose a reply to the voice note. Then decide what to do if the answer doesn't check out. Careful: it's his voice, send the money, is exactly what the scammer is counting on. A real relative can wait two minutes while you check.
scenes.dialogue: Passphrase first. Then call his saved number.

scenes.label: Chacha is safe
scenes.title: The voice was a clone.
scenes.caption: Chacha picks up on the first ring, completely fine and having breakfast at his hotel. The voice was a clone. Dad blocks the number and reports it at cybercrime.gov.in; if they had paid, they'd call 1930 at once. The rule: a familiar voice isn't proof. Ask for the passphrase, and call back on a number you saved yourself.

scenes.label: A happier ending
scenes.title: The family plan works
scenes.caption: That evening, Chacha video-calls the whole family, laughing and a little shaken. He makes his travel videos visible to friends only. Kabir teaches Nani the passphrase and how to call back. Dad hugs him: you kept us calm. Your turn: help Kabir spot more cloned-voice tricks and verify before anyone pays!
scenes.dialogue: Passphrase, call back, then relax. Deal?
